Optimize user experiences across all locations, devices, and apps
Your users and apps are everywhere, and poor performance can impact their productivity. Ensure satisfied users and flawless performance with digital experience monitoring (DEM).
Get unified visibility across devices, networks, and apps
Detect issues early and quickly pinpoint root causes using AI
Collaborate effectively using data across IT operations, support, and security teams
The problem
Poor technology experiences have serious consequences
Your users rely on 24/7 access to apps, data, and services—any slowdowns or outages can harm productivity, user engagement, and the customer experience. Unfortunately, legacy DEM solutions fail to provide IT with full visibility across devices, networks, and apps in today’s zero trust environments.

Product Overview
Ensure great user and customer experiences across all locations, devices, and apps
Zscaler Digital Experience™ (ZDX) enables network operations and service desk teams to keep users productive. By monitoring performance from within users' devices, across networks, and to SaaS, cloud, or data center apps, IT teams can rapidly detect, troubleshoot, and resolve user and customer experience issues.
52% faster mean time to resolution for IT issues
20% fewer work hours lost to IT-related downtime
End-to-end visibility across your zero trust environment

Monitor user experiences
Understand the digital experience of your apps and services from your users’ point of view.
Key offerings
User Experience Scoring
Get global views of user satisfaction. Drill down by regions, departments, and users.
Learn about ZDX Score
Per-User Details
Review each user’s score along with causes of poor experiences using AI.
Precise, Timely Alerts
Get alerts via email, IM, and tools like ServiceNow when anomalies are detected.
Fix performance issues
Instantly expose root causes using AI, and help users get back to work more quickly.
Key offerings
AI-Powered Root Cause Analysis
Quickly isolate root causes in devices, Wi-Fi, security services, networks, or apps.
See AI-powered analysis in action
AI Assistant—Zscaler Copilot
Conduct investigations and drill-downs by asking questions in natural language.
Robust API Integrations

or via our
API
to create tickets and support triage, analysis, and resolution.
Self-Service
Empower end users to fix issues within their control, such as poor Wi-Fi or high resource usage, with user-friendly, AI-powered guidance.
Monitor applications
Monitor apps from user devices and global locations to ensure users get uninterrupted service.
Key offerings
Application Monitoring
Observe apps running in your data center or cloud in addition to SaaS. Understand page fetch and DNS times.
UCaaS Monitoring
Monitor Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Webex meeting experiences to identify root causes of poor call quality.
Managed Monitoring
Monitor availability and performance of apps and services 24/7 from globally distributed locations.
Read about Managed Monitoring
Monitor networks
Maintain visibility across networks—even those not in your control—to support users no matter where they work.
ENLARGE
Key offerings
Global Network Health Monitoring
Baseline network performance, detect anomalies, and correlate user experience scores to accelerate issue resolution and enhance performance.
Hop-by-Hop Network Insights
Track latency and packet loss across multipath networks with detailed path visualization, analyze hops, identify top ISPs, and enable remote packet capture for troubleshooting.
ISP Insights
See how ISP issues like blackouts, brownouts, and high latency impact user experience.
Visit ISP Insights
Monitor devices
Maintain a complete picture of the devices and software in your organization. Get detailed insights for each device, no matter where it is.
Key offerings
Device Health Score
Proactively address device issues with a consolidated view of struggling devices across your organization.
Device Events Dashboard
Dedicated dashboards for critical events such as software crashes and system crashes (including BSOD).
Hardware Usage Analysis
Optimize resource allocation and reduce costs by analyzing real-time device usage and hardware profiling.
Get global insights
Review the impact of digital experience initiatives on employee productivity. See trends and seek opportunities to optimize.
Key offerings
ZDX Data Explorer Reports
Report on performance trends with built-in or custom templates. Combine, correlate, and visualize insights from diverse datasets.
Learn more
Insights for Regular Reviews
Generate slide decks for cross-functional team meetings. Set goals and take steps to further optimize digital experiences.
